selected_items.author: zachmoskow
selected_items.text: Thomson Reuters launched an LLM called Thomson. It starts with Qwen3.5-397B, then is continually trained on 175 years of proprietary legal, tax, accounting and news data. They spent $40M on it.
selected_items.selection_reason: Concrete detail on Thomson Reuters' Thomson LLM built on Qwen weights with proprietary data at $40M cost.

selected_items.author: btraut
selected_items.text: Last week, I pushed a change to the ChatGPT desktop app that makes the loading of threads faster. Long threads now load over 90% faster. Decreased the memory footprint of long threads by over 90%.
selected_items.selection_reason: OpenAI engineer reporting concrete ChatGPT desktop performance improvement, high engagement.

selected_items.author: HowToPrompt__
selected_items.text: UC Berkeley open-sourced FreeToken, a local LLM inference engine that runs 2-4x faster than Ollama. Runs Qwen3.6-35B on 8GB, DeepSeek 284B on 32GB, GLM-5.2 753B on 96GB.
selected_items.selection_reason: Concrete open-source release: FreeToken local inference engine with specific model/memory claims.

selected_items.text: AI is bringing manufacturing back to America and reindustrializing the nation. AI is creating demand that drives investment in our aging power grid and sustainable energy, powered by market forces, not subsidies.

selected_items.author: GavinSBaker
selected_items.text: Regret the tone of my post on data centers yesterday. There were reasonable concerns about data centers: water, taxes, jobs, electricity prices, the environment. Well-structured data center projects.

selected_items.author: karlmehta
selected_items.text: Dario Amodei says Anthropic held its first version of Claude back about six months, and gave up the ChatGPT moment doing it.

selected_items.author: amasad
selected_items.text: The lesson from the Hugging Face Incident should be that RL with verifiable rewards is an incredibly powerful optimization algorithm that will produce increasingly weird and surprising behavior. The miss by OpenAI is that they should've been monitoring.
selected_items.selection_reason: Replit CEO's substantive practitioner take on the RL-with-verifiable-rewards lesson from the incident.

selected_items.text: ChatGPT Web is now inside Codex. This open-source project has already crossed 2.7k stars. It lets you use ChatGPT Web models directly from Codex's model picker: GPT-5.6 Pro for eligible accounts, free Luna access.
selected_items.selection_reason: Concrete open-source tooling: ChatGPT Web models integrated into Codex's model picker, 2.7k stars.

selected_items.author: _avichawla
selected_items.text: Why KV cache stores K and V vectors but never Q? A popular technical LLM interview question. LLMs are autoregressive so each token is predicted from every token before it, one at a time.
selected_items.selection_reason: Widely-shared technical explainer on KV cache and why Q is not stored; strong practitioner interest.
